g.text: ADR-0047 — a window's save reaches every other window, never itself
before: the watcher broadcast to every REGISTERED window
type " " → the field and app-db hold "Noto "
vv:settings {"Noto"} — its OWN, now older, write
a later claim shows boot-time state
the draft is dropped: the space is GONE
now: main remembers what it wrote, and for whom
skipped = #{A} (the file still holds A's write)
A is sent nothing: it holds
an external change reaches everyone, the writer too
chokidar change → read the file: "Fira" ≠ last-write
renderer windows (live, or hidden in the warm pool)
main: the store, its watcher, the echo rule
